So the `PackSize<0` clamp is commented out. But `PackSize` is read as unsigned from the header, so it can't be negative from parsing. Unless... let me check if there's a way `PackSize` can become negative.

Wait - let me look at the `UnpPackedSize` assignment. In `UnpRead`, `UnpPackedSize` is used. Let me check where `UnpPackedSize` is set:

<｜｜DSML｜｜=execute_bash>
<parameter=command>grep -n "UnpPackedSize" /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/unrar/rdwrfn.cpp /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/unrar/extract.cpp /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/unrar/unpack.cpp 2>/dev/null | head -30</｜｜DSML｜｜>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
